title: Add MCP maintenance tools
description:
Problem: maintenance operations and topic-map/proposal context are active product surfaces, but MCP lacks run/status/topic-map tools for maintenance workflows. That prevents external clients and structured automations from using the same operational entry points as the app.

Desired outcome: expose bounded MCP maintenance tools for safe operational visibility and controlled run initiation where policy allows.

Scope:
- In scope: evaluate and add MCP tools such as `memorysmith_maintenance_run`, `memorysmith_maintenance_status`, and `memorysmith_topic_map_get` or equivalent naming.
- In scope: align permissions and result contracts with the current maintenance agent and topic-map services.
- In scope: document which maintenance actions are read-only versus mutating/admin-only.
- Out of scope: broad maintenance-agent redesign or changing scheduler semantics.

Validation:
- Focused tests for maintenance status/topic-map reads and any gated run initiation path.
- Docs/prompts updated for maintenance MCP usage.

Confidence target: 86%.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from MCP surface review because maintenance run/status/topic-map capabilities exist in-product but are not represented in the MCP tool contract.
